study.assay: construct-level DNA/RNA/protein measurements for synonymous N-terminal variants

clean_csv.additional_columns_policy: ignored and never selected or inspected for partitioning

source_qc_reference.note: Previously audited source QC metadata only; these values are not recomputed or used by the partitioner.

split.duplicate_policy: Preserve every row; each exact CDS and each Name must map to exactly one Gene, with cross-Gene conflicts fatal.
split.inner_fold_role: For each outer training pool, inner fold k is its validation Gene set and the other three inner folds form its training set.
split.algorithm: Process Genes in lexicographic order; among folds tied for the fewest assigned Genes, choose by SHA-256 of protocol, partition namespace, Gene and fold index, then by fold index.
split.outer_test_use: Outer test Genes are excluded from model fitting, feature selection, early stopping, hyperparameter selection and threshold selection for that outer evaluation.

outputs.split_json: Five outer test Gene sets and four inner Gene sets within every outer training pool, with input hashes and Gene/row counts.

limitations: This is a candidate clean-v3 partition, not a final untouched dataset designation or an evaluation result.
Only Gene-grouped N-terminal fragment construct OOD within the observed leader-context geometry is supported.
Gene diversity is not protein OOD evidence; full-length CDS and native-UTR generalization claims are unsupported.
No outcome, filter, expression, translation-count or leader-count value is used to assign folds.
No functional conclusion, scientific positive claim or model selection is authorized by this partition artifact.
